patent_summary: The document discloses a three-step batch synthesis of the triketone herbicide tembotrione (环磺酮) starting from methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate: benzylic bromination of the aryl methyl group with hydrobromic acid and dropwise hydrogen peroxide over a catalyst to give methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; displacement of that benzylic bromide by 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol over a base and a catalyst, carried through without isolation into alkaline hydrolysis of the methyl ester and acidification to 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; and conversion of that acid to its acid chloride with thionyl chloride followed by O-acylation of 1,3-cyclohexanedione under triethylamine and acetone-cyanohydrin-mediated rearrangement to the 2-aroylcyclohexane-1,3-dione. Dependent claims 2 to 10 recite the molar ratios of substrate to catalyst, brominating agent, oxidant, bases and reagents for each step, the identities of the step 1) radical catalyst, the step 2) two bases and amine catalyst and the step 3) catalyst, and the reaction and recrystallisation solvent options.
novelty_claims: The background at [0005] to [0009] objects to five named prior routes: CN1323292A and CN105601548A brominate with NBS, which [0006] calls "expensive" and which produces "a large amount of solid waste", at yields of only 67% and 75.2%; CN104292137A uses "the comparatively hazardous elemental bromine" at 69 to 70%, as does the 《农药》 (Pesticides) vol. 56 no. 5 paper; CN104292137A and CN106008290A both rely on sodium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide, which "cannot at present be produced on a large scale and the raw material cannot be bought"; and the 《农药》 route uses sodium methoxide, "flammable, explosive and sensitive to air and moisture", together with acetonitrile, which "belongs to the controlled, moderately toxic chemicals". Against those objections claim 1 step 1) recites bromination with "hydrobromic acid" and dropwise "hydrogen peroxide", and step 2) recites "2,2,2-trifluoroethanol" itself with potassium carbonate as base 1 (claim 6), the description at [0031] and [0032] positioning the first as cheaper and lower in safety risk and the second as "readily obtainable on the market", which "makes the process feasible for industrial-scale production". Claim 1 step 3) further carries the triethylamine-mediated acylation of 1,3-cyclohexanedione straight through to the acetone cyanohydrin addition without isolating the 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl ester that [0007] says a prior route had to work up "separately, which makes the process cumbersome", and [0090] closes by calling the hazard reduction "the core of this patent" while presenting the yield obtained as "unexpected". The toxicity positioning is asserted in the description rather than fenced by the claims: [0033] states that "DMF is used in place of acetonitrile", but claim 7 still lists "acetonitrile, DMF, acetone or tetrahydrofuran" as the step 2) solvent options, claim 10 recites DMF only as the step 3) catalyst and no claim defines the step 3) reaction solvent at all, so nothing in the claim set excludes acetonitrile.
